text:
Olga: CS flagged that several tenants (notably pacific-bikes) are getting routed to v1 when the client omits x-rw-version. They expected v2 during the SDK rollout.
Hector: That's expected today: missing header -> global default (v1). We chose safety over surprise.
Priya: For rollouts we should offer a per-tenant "implicit_preference" toggle in Console so teams can opt to be treated as v2 when header absent.
Olga: Important: this must be routing-only and the billing UI must show requested_version (header) vs routed_version so charges are clear. No silent reattribution.
Hector: Implementation sketch: add request metadata fields requested_version, routed_version, version_source in {explicit_header, tenant_flag, default}. Then dashboards can slice by those.
Priya: Safety nets: start with probe-weight (default 20%) for implicit->v2, sample outputs for N=1000 pairs, and fallback_on_error that routes individual failing requests back to v1. Also auto-rollback if implicit v2 5xx rate increases past threshold.
Olga: Console banner suggestion: "Missing client version header? Enable per-tenant implicit preference to reduce routing surprises during SDK rollouts. Routing only; billing shows requested vs routed."
console-bot: Draft banner created: /admin/tenants/{id}/settings -> "Implicit version preference" with help link.
telemetry-bot: Suggested SQL for dashboard: SELECT tenant_id, routed_version, sum(case when headers['x-rw-version'] IS NULL then tokens else 0 end) headerless_tokens FROM request_events WHERE timestamp > now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY tenant_id, routed_version ORDER BY headerless_tokens DESC;
Hector: Edge-case: some customers intentionally omit headers; we must keep opt-in only. Do not change global default.
Olga: Agree. Ops plan: short-lived override for pacific-bikes to treat missing header as v2 at 25% probe for 1h while CS finishes rollout communication. Can we record that run and metric slices?
ops-bot: deploy: routing-override-pacific-bikes started by Hector - probe_weight=25%, window=60m
Priya: I'll add trace tags (version_source, requested_version) and a dashboard slice so CS sees requested vs routed side-by-side. Also will add a tenant badge showing % headerless traffic.
Hector: I'll implement the fallback-on-error rule and the auto-rollback threshold (5xx delta > 0.5% or fallback rate > 0.5% of implicit traffic).
Olga: Thanks. After 30m if probe looks stable we can recommend tenant flip the Console toggle to 100%.
ops-bot: deploy: routing-override-pacific-bikes completed - status=active, probe_weight=25%
Olga: First 30m OK; sampled diffs small, no spike in 5xx. Will keep monitoring and follow up with CS.
